# @epochtm/v12-cli

Official command-line client for Epoch V12 mission and worker operations.

Use the CLI from a terminal, CI job, or worker host to inspect missions, create governed work, and inspect registered workers.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g @epochtm/v12-cli
pnpm add -g @epochtm/v12-cli
bun add -g @epochtm/v12-cli
```

## Configure

```bash
# PowerShell
$env:EPOCH_V12_API_URL = "http://localhost:3011"
$env:EPOCH_V12_API_KEY = "your-workspace-scoped-key"
$env:EPOCH_V12_WORKSPACE_ID = "workspace-id"
```

The API key is sent as a bearer token. Keep it out of shell history and source control when using a production workspace.

## Commands

List missions:

```bash
epoch-v12 missions list --workspace=workspace-id
```

Create a mission:

```bash
epoch-v12 missions create \
  --workspace=workspace-id \
  --institution=institution-id \
  --title="Verify deployment" \
  --objective="Confirm the deployment is healthy" \
  --acceptance="health check passes|evidence is recorded"
```

List workers:

```bash
epoch-v12 workers list --workspace=workspace-id
```

The workspace can also be supplied through `EPOCH_V12_WORKSPACE_ID`.

## Output and failures

Successful commands print JSON to stdout so they can be piped into other tools. Errors print to stderr and return a non-zero exit code.

## Scope

This CLI uses the versioned Epoch V12 runtime API. It does not wrap the legacy SDK, API, MCP, onboarding, GitHub setup, dashboard, Account, or Organization UI flows.

## Development

```bash
npm run build
node dist/index.js missions list --workspace=workspace-id
```
